context:
Goal: a ruling you gave closes only once it really holds on main.
Problem (goal): the lane took this undoable pick today without asking you: the check closes a ruling as soon as its home file exists on main, so a ruling homed to a file that already exists closes before its edit lands.
Based on (ruling): R27 point 1, a ruling closes when main holds it; the lane read "holds it" as "its home file is on main".
Based on (read): a ruling homed to a roadmap step never closes this way, since the step is the open work; the gap is written down as a debt.
Departs from: main has no such close — PR #2915 adds one that reads the file's presence, not its text.

lastAnswer.note: ask retrospective im not confident in a

options.gain: Small and ships now with PR #2915.
options.how: As built: the ruling closes once its home file is on main; the debt records that the text is not read. Undo: pick b later.
options.label: Close on the file (Recommended)
options.lose: A ruling homed to an existing file shows closed before its edit lands.

options.gain: A closed ruling always holds on main.
options.how: The check reads the home file and closes the ruling only when a line from it is there.
options.label: Close only when the ruling's text is on main
options.lose: Each ruling needs a line to match, and the lane grows.

ref: lane prose-tending-contract 15:48 CST Nov 12; PR #2915, PR #2996; debt feedback-close-reads-file-only
reply: 00:54 CST Nov 13, triage: the retrospective's read, as you asked: b, in a cheap form. A ruling closes when its home file is on main and that file carries the ruling's own stamp (your time or the item number, plus at least one quoted word of yours). That is one read of one file, with no wording match. Evidence that a closes too early: tonight two feedback items passed the check on an unrelated file that only existed (fb-2325-2 on step fix-check-chain, fb-2159-7), and two live home files kept text your later ruling reversed (Degen's shared-sim-lease rule; plan R61 part 3 said skip nightly for 3 h after you said drop it). Limit: b proves the ruling is written down, not that anything enforces it. Your a stands until you pick again; the lane holds.
short: Close on file, not on its text
title: A ruling closes once its home file is on main, before its edit lands
why: The lane took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
